title: Nevis, which uses AI to automate paperwork for financial advisors, raised a $70M Series B led by EQT Ventures, a source says at a $500M valuation (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
summary: Camila Grigera Naón / Fortune: Nevis, which uses AI to automate paperwork for financial advisors, raised a $70M Series B led by EQT Ventures, a source says at a $500M valuation — Americans want more financial advisors, but every day there are fewer to go around. One New York-based startup wants to help ease the squeeze …
contentText:
Camila Grigera Naón / Fortune :

Nevis, which uses AI to automate paperwork for financial advisors, raised a $70M Series B led by EQT Ventures, a source says at a $500M valuation   —  Americans want more financial advisors, but every day there are fewer to go around.  One New York-based startup wants to help ease the squeeze …
